arguments.command:
python -c "
from itertools import combinations_with_replacement
from more_itertools import nth_combination_with_replacement

# Test nth_combination_with_replacement
elements = 'ABCD'
r = 2

combs = list(combinations_with_replacement(elements, r))
print('All combinations:', combs)

for i in range(len(combs)):
    result = nth_combination_with_replacement(elements, r, i)
    expected = combs[i]
    status = 'OK' if result == expected else 'FAIL'
    print(f'  index {i}: {result} (expected {expected}) [{status}]')
"
